# Complete native normal Pyramid ordinals

These three single-frame 1920×1080 PNGs are unchanged copies of Charlie's
Capture PNG originals. The complete top-right `Boards: n of 3` header identifies
the current ordinal: one, two and three mean zero, one and two completed boards.
The complete `New` footer remains independently required. The first image has
taskbar previews outside both measured rectangles.

`header-2.rgb` and `header-3.rgb` contain all row-major RGB8 pixels from
`[1658,46,160,32]` of their corresponding original, exactly 15,360 bytes each.
No masks, OCR, digit replacement, resizing or alignment are used. The existing
ordinal-one and `New` RGB references and their inclusive channel tolerances of
12 and 10 remain unchanged. Each reference is exclusive against the other two.

These are finite recognition references, not live Continuous, board-clear,
GAME WIN, restart or challenge-completion evidence. Two and three display
`0 deals left`; this observation does not define or alter redeal rules.
Synthetic corruption and transition tests are labelled separately in source.
